dependencies.scope: Future optional application-owned platform context; no direct CO-to-Kloz adapter header exists yet. CO remains independently buildable.
Optional health observer bridge; refresh only after a completed successful poll and never actuates hardware.

boundaries: CO is not an RTOS, thread scheduler, or interrupt scheduler.
CO does not allocate from a hidden heap or write MMIO.
The application serializes access from independent execution contexts.

verification.host_tests: Host unit tests are documented; run make test.
verification.target_validation: Target timing and callback behavior require application/board validation.
